sentences.text: donut (View): chartType: donut. The color encoding maps destination categories as follows: blue represents Developing East Asia; cyan represents Europe and Central Asia; orange represents High income Asia and Pacific; brown represents Middle East and North Africa; green represents North America; golden yellow represents South America and Caribbean; light green represents South Asia; and dark navy blue represents Sub-Saharan Africa.
Export share percentage (Data Variable): name: Export share percentage; unit: %; variableType: Quantitative.
Europe and Central Asia, High income Asia and Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, and North America each comprise an individual sector mark representing export share of value.

South Asia has an Export share percentage of 1.0%, making it the visually supported global Export share percentage minimum from the destination subgroup comparisons, which also include Sub-Saharan Africa at 2.0%, Middle East and North Africa at 5.0%, South America and Caribbean at 10.0%, Europe and Central Asia at 11.0%, High income Asia and Pacific at 20.0%, and North America at 28.0%.
